components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action on an authority surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary, #151d27); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 16px/1.25 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #151d27) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #18a9ce) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bounded alternative beside the decisive action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9e1e8); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--background, #f4f7f9); color: var(--foreground, #111820); font: 500 16px/1.25 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--muted, #eef3f6); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #18a9ce) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Attention Chip
components.description: Signals that execution needs a human decision.
components.html: Needs you
components.css: .ds-chip-attention { display: inline-flex; height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--attention-field, #fff2d5); color: var(--attention, #9a6100); font: 600 14px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-attention svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Decision Card
components.description: The single lifted surface for the active authority decision.
components.html:
AgentOS is paused

A database change is outside your mandate.

The agent stopped before making the change.
components.css: .ds-decision-card { max-width: 760px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9e1e8); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #111820); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(17, 24, 32, 0.05); font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-decision-card h2 { margin: 20px 0 8px; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-decision-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #596778); font-size: 18px; } .ds-decision-state { color: var(--attention, #9a6100); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: The current destination in the graphite rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { display: flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--sidebar-accent, #202b38); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font: 400 14px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-selected svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #18a9ce) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Alexa Control Band
components.description: A high-contrast voice-control prompt with verified identity.
components.html:
Alexa+

Should I ask the agent to find another way?
components.css: .ds-alexa-band { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 24px 32px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--sidebar, #121a24); color: var(--sidebar-foreground, #e8eef4); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(18, 26, 36, 0.15); font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-alexa-band p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 20px; } .ds-alexa-ring { width: 48px; height: 48px; flex: none; border: 5px solid var(--verified, #079bc1); border-radius: 999px; }

narrative.overview:
Mandate is an operational control surface for understanding delegated authority and acting on exceptions. It pairs a dark graphite navigation rail with a cool, quiet workspace so the interface feels exact and durable without becoming a developer console.

The hierarchy gives authority deltas, boundaries, alternatives, and evidence more visual weight than product chrome. It is calm rather than alarming and administrative rather than futuristic; color is sparse enough that attention and verified identity remain unmistakable.
keyCharacteristics: Dark persistent rail beside a cool reading field
One dominant decision surface, followed by evidence and immutable scope
Amber for blocked expansion; cyan for Alexa-backed identity
Crisp borders, restrained ambient depth, and explicit plain-language actions

rules.name: The Semantic Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Amber never decorates; cyan never acts as a generic link color; status always includes language or iconography in addition to color.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when the underlying value is machine-shaped and benefits from character-level inspection.

rules.name: The Decision-First Rule
rules.body: A consequential state and its available choices appear before history, evidence, or scope detail.

rules.name: The One-Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation identifies the active decision; routine rows and nested fields remain flat.

dos: Do put the current authority boundary next to the decision it governs.
Do name the exact authority delta and a compliant alternative before asking for approval.
Do keep interaction targets at least 44px and retain visible keyboard focus.
Do use native landmarks, headings, buttons, links, and `aria-current` for active navigation.
Do keep approved scope visually stable while an amendment is reviewed or rejected.
donts: Don't use generic warning banners without a next action.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, neon glows, or decorative charts.
Don't create equal-weight dashboard card grids or nest cards inside cards.
Don't use red for routine blocked authority expansion.
Don't hide authority changes behind ambiguous confirmation language or narrow viewports.
